name: Chromie
description: A long range, high burst damage Mage, who requires good timing and setup.
title: Keeper of Time
info: At first glance, Chromie appears to be an ordinary gnome. In truth, she is Chronormu, Bronze Dragon and a master of time. When it comes to temporal manipulation there's no problem she can't solve... with some help from her future self, of course.

Chromie.name: Sand Blast
Chromie.description: After 0.8 seconds, fire a missile that deals 315 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.  Quest: Hit 50 Heroes with Sand Blast. Consecutive hits without missing count as hitting 2 Heroes.  Reward: After hitting 50 Heroes, casting Sand Blast leaves an Echo behind.  The next time Sand Blast is cast, the Echo also casts an untalented Sand Blast that deals 40% damage.

Chromie.name: Dragon's Breath
Chromie.description: Fire a blast into the air that lands after 1.5 seconds, dealing 390 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area.

Chromie.name: Time Trap
Chromie.description: Place a Time Trap that arms and Stealths after 2 seconds. The first enemy Hero to touch it is placed in Time Stop for 2 seconds. Only 1 trap can exist at once.

Chromie.name: Temporal Loop
Chromie.description: Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they will teleport back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them.

Chromie.name: Slowing Sands
Chromie.description: Place a sand vortex that greatly Slows enemies inside it. The longer it is active the more it Slows, up to 60% after 3 seconds.

Chromie.name: Timewalker
Chromie.description: Chromie has traveled to the future, and as such, will learn her Talents 2 levels earlier than her teammates!  Bronze Talons  Hitting an enemy Hero with a Basic Ability increases the damage of Chromie's next Basic Attack by 140%.

Chromie.name: Hearthstone
Chromie.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Altar, instantly restoring 1125 Health and 150 Mana.

1.name: Mounting Sand
1.description: Increase the damage of Echo's Sand Blast by 50%. Hitting 3 or more consecutive Sand Blasts without missing counts as hitting 3 Heroes.

1.name: Deep Breathing
1.description: Quest: Every time Dragon's Breath hits a Hero increase its damage by 5, up to 60.  Reward: After hitting 12 Heroes, increase its damage by an additional 140 and also increase Chromie's sight radius by 100%.

1.name: Timewalker's Pursuit
1.description: Activate to reveal the targeted area for 2 seconds. Enemies seen are revealed for 4 seconds.  Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.  Reward: After gathering 15 Globes, Chromie gains 5% Spell Power and her Mana Regeneration is increased by 1.

4.name: Draconic Barrage
4.description: Increase the damage from Bronze Talons by an additional 100%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast applies Bronze Talons to Chromie's next 2 Basic Attacks.

4.name: Timely Surprise
4.description: Increase Time Trap's cast range by 33%. Additionally, the cooldowns of Sand Blast and Dragon's Breath are reset when Time Trap is triggered.

7.name: Mobius Loop
7.description: If Dragon's Breath hits a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds and restore 100 Mana.

7.name: Dragon's Eye
7.description: Dragon's Breath deals 25% more damage to enemies in the center.

7.name: Chrono Sickness
7.description: Reduce Time Trap's cooldown and Mana cost by 50%. After the Time Stop ends, the enemy is also Slowed by 35% for 4 seconds.

10.name: Slowing Sands
10.description: Place a sand vortex that greatly Slows enemies inside it. The longer it is active the more it Slows, up to 60% after 3 seconds.

10.name: Temporal Loop
10.description: Choose an enemy Hero. After 3 seconds, they will teleport back to the location where Temporal Loop was cast on them.

13.name: Bye Bye!
13.description: Reduce the cast time of Hearthstone by 75%, and it is not interrupted by taking damage.

13.name: Here and There
13.description: Activate to swap Chromie's position with her Sand Blast Echo.

13.name: Time Out
13.description: Activate to place Chromie in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for up to 5 seconds. Can be reactivated to end the effect early.

16.name: Shifting Sands
16.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Sand Blast grants 8% Spell Power for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 40%. The duration is refreshed whenever an enemy is damaged by Sand Blast.

16.name: Fast Forward
16.description: If Sand Blast travels at least 70% of its base distance and hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced to 0.75 seconds.

16.name: Quantum Overdrive
16.description: Activate to increase Spell Power by 25% for 10 seconds.

20.name: Pocket of Time
20.description: Remove Slowing Sands Mana cost and increase the Slow from 60% to 80%.

20.name: Stuck in a Loop
20.description: Temporal Loop teleports the target a second time after the first.

20.name: Piercing Sands
20.description: Sand Blast will now hit all Heroes in its path. Additional hits do not grant Quest progress.

20.name: Andorhal Anomaly
20.description: Time Trap gains 2 charges, and when the cooldown finishes, Chromie gains all charges at once. Maximum 3 active Time Traps.
